notes: FOOTPASS (Footovision Play-by-Play Action Spotting in Soccer) -- 54 complete top-European matches (2023-24) behind the SoccerNet 2026 Player-Centric Ball-Action Spotting challenge. Acquisition, file inventory, disk math and the 14-column tactical schema are documented in docs/reference/footpass-setup.md; read that before touching this tier.

Data acquisition is out-of-band and NOT part of any ingest command, and it is double-gated: the Hugging Face repo SoccerNet/SN-PCBAS-2026 is access-restricted (a read token authenticates, but the account must ALSO be granted access on the dataset page -- 401 = token/scope problem, 403 = valid token not on the authorized list). MEASURED 2026-07-27: the tactical_data_*.zip archives are NOT encrypted, so the SoccerNet NDA password is not needed for this tier (the video zips are presumably the encrypted ones, unverified -- none downloaded). Beware that unzip -P succeeds silently on an unencrypted archive, so a successful extraction does not confirm a password. Neither secret is recorded in this repo; both live in the gitignored .env as HF_TOKEN and SOCCERNET_NDA_PASSWORD. Place extracted data under data/footpass/{tactical,videos_352x640,videos_fullHD}/.

ACQUIRED 2026-07-27: the tactical tier is on disk and schema-verified -- data/footpass/tactical/{train,val,challenge}_tactical_data.h5 (9.3 GB extracted; 96/6/6 keys = 48/3/3 matches; 14 columns for train+val, 13 for challenge which omits the withheld action class). No video downloaded (25.7 GB low-res / 206 GB full-HD, deferred). No sequences are recorded below because no ingest adapter exists yet -- this remains an intentionally empty starter manifest, the same pattern as soccernet-ball.json, not a gap. Ingesting means mapping the tactical rows onto matchlab_core.gt.GroundTruth (PLAYER_ID as track identity, SHIRT_NUMBER as the jersey identity the semantic-identity layer scores against); see docs/reference/footpass-setup.md for the four confirmed adapter hazards (split-dependent width, NaN-as-observability-flag, halves as separate keys, full-HD box scale).

INTENDED ROLE POLICY, recorded before any data exists so it cannot be chosen after seeing results: the 3 val matches are the first ingest and are TUNING (they are the natural development set and will be used iteratively). Held-out matches must be drawn from the 48-match train pool and, per this directory's rules, never referenced by a tuning config, experiment YAML or ablation sweep. source_split below records val as the first intended ingest, not a restriction on the tier.

WHY THIS TIER MATTERS BEYOND B4: filed as a B4 (action attribution) asset for reproducing TAAD/TAAD+GNN/TAAD+DST, but it is also the only available substrate on which B2 role/zone occupancy evidence is measurable -- SoccerNet tracking clips are 30 s / 750 frames, and a positional footprint needs minutes. It supplies full-match track-level identity, ground-truth pitch positions/velocities, and 13 ground-truth tactical roles per team.

BOUNDS ON USE: FOOTPASS SUPPLIES tracking, jersey and role as inputs, so it can never be a benchmark for PRODUCING identity -- it is a development and isolation substrate, not a do-no-harm gate (same standing caution as the GT-fragment harness, docs/implementation-status.md). Its challenge metric requires jersey-number match at a fixed high-recall threshold (tau = 0.15), the opposite end of the curve from this repo's abstention-first design. Broadcast footage, so the amateur-phone-footage domain gap remains.

LICENSE/REDISTRIBUTION: NDA-gated broadcast footage from commercial competitions. Recorded as a provenance and redistribution fact, not a capability gate (CLAUDE.md -> Licensing notes, research posture): never redistribute the videos or the tactical data, and never commit the NDA password.
